title: 6 Day Powerbuilding (Base+Peak)
author: Vukoje P.
desc: Introducing my 13-Week Powerbuilding Program: The ultimate training plan designed for serious lifters who want to build muscle, increase strength, and crush their 1-rep max on the bench press, squat, overhead press, and deadlift. Whether you're aiming to improve your raw strength or build a physique that turns heads, this program combines the best of both worlds—powerlifting for maximal strength gains and bodybuilding for muscle growth and definition.
